triples.evidence: - `FINDINGS-FOR-THE-STANDARD.md`: six findings, each with evidence, grade, and the concrete change proposed
A living "AI authoring guide for X3D 4.0": the verified rule packs, one page, generated from the winning prompts with provenance.
Questions for Dr. Polys and Don Brutzman (Immersive coverage of PhysicalMaterial/UnlitMaterial; is Full an acceptable default; should a scene contract exist).
Re-integration: findings go to the University-scale hub (sent 19:00Z) so the photo-to-X3D A/Bs use the no-Full prompt.
Validator wording steers the optimiser | Full adopted 2/2 with default hint, 0/2 with reworded hints | Likely (n = 2 per arm)
So the next lap optimises the prompt for the residual (H-Anim containers, Geo nodes, Disk2D/UnlitMaterial components, route types), with the ladder in the loop. That is E-G.
Classes 4 and 5 of F7 (opaque GLSL and ECMAScript) are not decidable from the XML; X_ITE load plus a non-blank check is the cheapest oracle ($0, ~2 s). E-G adds it

Proposed for the fork, all info-level so validity numbers do not move: `profile-overbroad`, `hidden-content` (headlight off with no lights, Switch whichChoice -1, one-point Extrusion spine, ClipPlane over all content
Fork changes proposed (on our fork only): `profile-overbroad` lint, `scene-draws-nothing` lint, PBR-on-Material hint and fixer, reworded profile hint.
MIPROv2 context optimisation (E-D) deferred until E-G reports.
